newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India expected to buy two kerosene cargoes for Dec.
newsitem.headline: India expected to buy two kerosene cargoes for Dec.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) is expected to buy two cargoes of superior kerosene in its tender for December delivery, traders said on Friday.
The best offers for cargoes to be delivered to Bombay on the Indian west coast was from a Dutch trader at $1.59 and $1.69 per barrel over MidEast spot quotes, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.

The Dutch trader also made a low offer of $2.37 per barrel over MidEast spot quotes, c-and-f Madras or Haldia on the east coast. A German trader offered an east coast cargo around $2.45 per barrel over MidEast quotes, c-and-f.
